# llms.txt — Workplace Learning With AI (WLWAI)

You are working in the WLWAI multi-service repository.

## What this repo is
A modular AI-powered workplace learning and agent platform:
- FastAPI backend (Python) + MongoDB
- React frontend
- Node websearch backend
- Optional n8n automation (AgentOps Studio)
- MCP server (J-messages Analyzer) accessible via STDIO bridge (Postman/Claude)

## Golden rules
- Backend MUST be started from repo ROOT:
  `python -m uvicorn backend.app:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000`
- Default ports:
  backend 8000, frontend 3000, websearch 3001, n8n 5678, LM Studio 1234, MCP file server 8888.
- Never commit secrets.
- Avoid heavyweight dependencies (Voice Cloning was discontinued due to bloat).

## Repo map (where to look)
- `backend/` — FastAPI routers, services, LLM orchestration, MCP bridge
- `frontend/` — React UI modules (J-messages Analyzer, Robomind Clinic, Repo Analyzer, etc.)
- `websearch-backend/` — Node service (port 3001)
- `agentops-n8n/` — Docker-based n8n workflows (optional)
- `docs/` — documentation and module guides

## Key modules & API contracts

### J-messages Analyzer (Fiskeridirektoratet)
Backend routers/services:
- `backend/routers/j_messages_analyzer.py`
- `backend/routers/j_messages_training.py`
- `backend/services/j_messages_evaluator.py`
- `backend/services/prompt_suggestion_service.py`

Frontend:
- `frontend/src/JMessagesAnalyzer.jsx`
- `frontend/src/JMessagesLibrary.jsx`
- `frontend/src/JMessagesPairsLibrary.jsx`
- `frontend/src/components/PromptPanel.jsx`

Analysis output commonly includes:
`{ id, title, status, toc, body_html, summary }`

Prompts:
- Versioned native prompts: `backend/prompts/j_messages/v{version}/`
- Each analysis records the prompt version used.

### Prompt Manager (Compliance & Productivity)
Backend endpoints:
- `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/prompts/{agent}`
- `POST /api/prompts/{agent}/test`
Structured test outputs:
- compliance: `{ ok, output, summary, risks }`
- productivity: `{ ok, output, summary, actions }`

Storage:
- MongoDB `prompts` collection.

### Robomind Clinic (AI Psychology)
Enhanced (competition) API:
- `POST /api/robomind/screen`
- `POST /api/robomind/therapy`
- `POST /api/robomind/apply`
- `GET /api/robomind/dashboard/metrics`
- `GET /api/robomind/cases/{id}`

Validation:
- `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_robomind_api_contracts.py -v`

### Repo Analyzer Cursor AI
Backend endpoints:
- `POST /api/cursor-readme/upload-files`
- `POST /api/cursor-readme/generate`
- `POST /api/cursor-readme/save-learning-module`
- `GET /api/cursor-readme/learning-modules`
- `GET /api/cursor-readme/learning-module/{module_id}`

Purpose:
- architectural-aware README generation + learning module creation.

### Cybersecurity Module
Backend router: `backend/routers/cybersecurity.py` (1499 lines)
Agent security: `backend/routers/agent_security.py` (785 lines)
Models: `backend/models/cyber_models.py`
Frontend: `frontend/src/cyber/` (11 components)

10 sub-tabs — all implemented:
- Dashboard, Agent Security, Threat Library, Tools & Frameworks
- Posture & Risk, Vulnerabilities, Secure Coding Coach
- Compliance Tracker, Incident Drills, Knowledge Base

Key API groups (`/api/cyber/`):
- `/threats`, `/controls` — 4 threats, 22 controls across 5 frameworks
- `/vulnerabilities/*`, `/vulnerabilities/scan` — real npm/pip/secret scanning
- `/posture/kpis`, `/posture/nist-domains`, `/risk/score` — NIST CSF 2.0
- `/compliance/status`, `/compliance/summary`, `PUT /compliance/{fw}/{ctrl}` — 22 controls
- `/coach/topics`, `/coach/lesson/topic/{id}`, `/coach/history` — 10 topics
- `/drills/scenarios`, `/drills/start/{id}`, `/drills/{id}/action` — 6 scenarios
- `/knowledge/articles`, `/rag/ask` — 8 articles + Q&A

Agent Security (`/api/agent-security/`):
- `/overview`, `/scan`, `/incidents`, `/incidents/{id}/respond`
- Uses MongoDB (`security_events`, `agent_security_status`) with mock fallback

Data: in-memory (resets on restart) except Agent Security (MongoDB).

## MCP (Postman / Claude)
- Manifest: `GET http://localhost:8000/api/mcp/manifest`
- Bridge: `backend/mcp_bridge_server.py` (STDIO JSON-RPC)
- Test file server: `python backend/test_mcp_server.py` (serves local files on `http://localhost:8888/...`)

Typical MCP tools:
- `list_j_meldinger`
- `analyze_j_melding` (input includes `file_url`)

## How to validate changes
Follow `docs/TESTING.md` for the minimum smoke gates per subsystem.
